text_block_list.text:
It's so unfaaair that only you and Mama 
get to go on a trip!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I wanted to go to Hawaii too!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Geez! Sure, I had a fever, but it went 
down and I felt fine...!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I won't forgive you unless you bring back 
100 souvenirs~~!
